breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly used parallel-flow temperature differences (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,in and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,out) for a counterflow heat exchanger. The generated specification correctly uses the counterflow temperature differences: ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in, which matches the ground truth.
